title: Sanglechi language - Wikipedia
text: May 4, 2026 - Sanglechi is a Pamiri language spoken in villages in the Zebak District of Afghanistan: Dashte Rubat, Eskatul, Faruq, Flaxmadek, Sar-Sanglech, and Takya. It is also spoken in Tajikistan, where it is called Sanglich. The name originates from the Sanglech Valley, in which many of the people live.

title: Sanglechi Language (SGY) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use | Ethnologue Free
text: Sanglechi is a stable indigenous language of Afghanistan. It belongs to the Indo-European language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
